verdict.rationale: Reflect documents in-app, one-click publishing of individual notes to a public, unlisted URL with clean minimal styling, so the core 'publish from within the app' part is covered. Nothing shows the published notes forming a browsable site or that links between published notes resolve. Missing for 10: a browsable multi-note website/digital-garden structure, working inter-note links on published pages, selection/management of a published set, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can publish selected notes as a browsable website — a digital garden with working links — without leaving the app

citations.quote: Reflect offers one-click publishing of your notes. Simply hit the publish button and your note will be publicly available behind a long hard-to-guess url.
We try to keep the style clean and branding to a minimum.
